Definition: a sistrum (so called from its rattling sound)
BiblicalUsage: Mena'na' is a sistrum, a rattle used as a musical instrument, and it sounds once, in the noisiest worship in the Bible. 2 Samuel 6:5 has David and all the house of Israel playing before the LORD on harps and psalteries and timbrels and cornets and cymbals, and on rattles besides.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God loves a loud, glad noise when His people bring the ark home, and even a rattle has its part in it.
RelatedEvents: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem
